description:
Send invoices conveniently and securely using regibill.

regibill desktop allows the easy and convenient sending of invoices using regibill standard and regibill premium. You deposit the invoices into the processing directory and regibill desktop will extract the recipient addresses from the PDF files, registers the transactions and sends the invoices via e-mail (SMTP) by pressing a single button. Optionally, you can automatically extract more values from the PDF files (using regular expressions) and use them in the message body and subject. It also offers you an option to split PDF files to single pages. The used e-mail messages can be adopted freely to your needs.
